title: Family of God
verse: For whoever does the will of God is my brother and sister and mother.
observation: God calls us to be in His family. This is such an awesome thing. I love that He says we can be born again, not just do better.
application: How would I live today if I realized I was in the family of God and was counted as His child?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for all You have done for us. We are so thankful to be counted as Yours.
